description: This is a C# source file defining the NotificationsController class in an ASP.NET Core Web API project. The controller handles HTTP requests related to notifications, including retrieval, deletion, and status updates.

classes.name: NotificationsController
classes.description: API controller managing notifications with endpoints for retrieval, deletion, and patching notification statuses.

methods.name: GetMany
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a list of notifications, optionally filtered by status.

methods.name: DeleteOne
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to delete a notification by its ID, with auditing.

methods.name: PatchOne
methods.description: Handles PATCH request to update the status of a specific notification identified by ID.

methods.name: PatchMany
methods.description: Handles PATCH request to update the status of multiple notifications based on a list of IDs.
